/* ASH common logic. Generated by ASH from input.xlsx; do not edit (user hooks live in user_ext.m). */
begin model initialization function
	open "arc/params.txt" for reading save result as V_fp
	read V_tok, V_seed from V_fp
	read V_tok, V_n from V_fp
	if V_n <> {{GROUP_COUNT}} then begin
		print "ASH: params.txt GROUPS " V_n " does not match model " {{GROUP_COUNT}} to message
		terminate
	end
	set V_i to 1
	while V_i <= V_n do begin
		read V_tmp, V_active(V_i) from V_fp
		inc V_i by 1
	end
	read V_tok, V_n from V_fp
	if V_n <> {{MATERIAL_COUNT}} then begin
		print "ASH: params.txt MATERIALS " V_n " does not match model " {{MATERIAL_COUNT}} to message
		terminate
	end
	set V_i to 1
	while V_i <= V_n do begin
		read V_tmp, V_call(V_i), V_unload(V_i), V_stock(V_i), V_safety(V_i), V_takt(V_i), V_perCycle(V_i), V_perContainer(V_i) from V_fp
		set V_need(V_i) to V_perCycle(V_i) / V_perContainer(V_i)
		set V_minStock(V_i) to 1000000000
		inc V_i by 1
	end
	read V_tok, V_simLen, V_warmup, V_deadlockSec from V_fp
	read V_tok, V_debug from V_fp
	set V_events to 0
	read V_tok from V_fp
	if V_tok = "EVENTS" then read V_events from V_fp
	close V_fp
	set V_fp to null
	if V_events = 1 then begin
		open "events.tsv" for writing save result as V_ev
		print "t\tkind\tmat\tcp\tvalue" to V_ev
	end
{{FAIL_INIT}}
	if V_debug = 1 then print "ASH: params ok, groups " {{GROUP_COUNT}} " materials " {{MATERIAL_COUNT}} " sim " V_simLen " warmup " V_warmup to message
{{CREATE_CONSUMERS}}
	return true
end

{{GROUP_LOGIC}}
{{MATERIAL_LOGIC}}
begin model snap function
	open "result.tsv" for writing save result as V_out
	print "kind\tname\tgroup\tvalue1\tvalue2\tvalue3\tvalue4\tvalue5\tvalue6\tvalue7\tvalue8" to V_out
{{SNAP_ROWS}}
	print "deadlock\tdeadlock\t\t" V_deadlock "\t0\t0\t0\t0\t0\t0\t0" to V_out
	set V_x to ac
	print "clock\tclock\t\t0\t" V_x "\t0\t0\t0\t0\t0\t0" to V_out
	set V_tmp to F_ext_on_snap()
	if V_debug = 1 then print "ASH: snap written at " V_x to message
	close V_out
	set V_out to null
	if V_events = 1 then begin
		close V_ev
		set V_ev to null
	end
	return true
end
